# PocketPans

> PocketPans makes fillable silicone bakeware. A pan and a matching insert bake a ready-made pocket into cupcakes, personal pizzas and pies, so there is no coring or cutting. Sold on Amazon. A Paulegone brand.

## Products

- PocketCakes: standard size. Three silicone pans with four cavities each (12 per batch) and twelve matching inserts. For cupcakes, muffins, mini cheesecakes, egg bites, mousse cups and tarts. Launch price $19.88.
- PocketPies: personal size. Three silicone pans with three larger cavities each (9 per batch) and nine matching inserts. For personal deep-dish pizzas, pot pies, hand pies, quiches, calzones and bread bowls. Launch price $21.88.

## Key facts

- 4-in-1: use the pan alone, the insert alone to make mini bakes, the pan and insert together to bake a fillable pocket, or bake two flavors in one bake.
- Material: food-grade, BPA-free, non-stick silicone.
- Heat-safe up to 450°F. Dishwasher safe, oven safe and freezer safe.
- Storage: the pans nest into each other (a full set stores in the footprint of one pan) and the inserts stack on their own (12 or 9 in the footprint of one). The pans cannot be stacked while baking.
- Buy: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GPR6FM7M (both products are on one Amazon listing).
